guide.industrialcrops.start.welcome.body:
Industrial Crops turns farming into a factory. You start with a single field, convert vanilla crops into industrial crops, then feed the harvest into machines, storage networks and power grids.

This manual follows that path chapter by chapter. Use the tabs on the left to jump between chapters and the arrows below to turn pages. Lost it? Craft a new one from a Book, Wheat Seeds and a Copper Ingot.
guide.industrialcrops.start.roadmap.body:
Progress is measured in device casings. Each tier unlocks the next set of machines:

• Copper: crop conversion, compression, mixing and basic crop storage.
• Iron: manipulation devices, pipes, crop analysis and slime machines.
• Gold: components, bio-energy, power grids and matter data.
• Crystal Steel: plasma, 5×5 crafting and wireless machines.
• Paradox Steel: Carrote technology and stable matter.
guide.industrialcrops.start.tips.title: Reading the Machines
guide.industrialcrops.start.tips.body:
Hold Shift over any machine in your inventory to read what it does. Most machine screens explain their slots with short hints.

With JEI installed, every special recipe in this mod (conversion, manipulation, mixing, programming, crystal workbench) is listed in its own category. Advancements under the Industrial Crops tab mark each milestone described in this manual.

Hover an item in this manual to see its name; the panel on the right shows its recipe when one exists.
Three things get your farm started:

• Redstone Bonemeal: 8 Redstone around 1 Bone Meal makes 4. Every crop conversion uses one.
• Empty Bags: 8 Paper around 1 String makes 4. Bags carry seeds and harvests.
• Copper Device Casing: Copper Ingots and Planks. It is the frame of every copper-tier machine.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.conversion.b:
The Basic Crop Conversion Device turns vanilla crops into industrial ones. Load the crop, a Redstone Bonemeal and, when required, an Empty Bag.

• Carrot / Potato → Bagged Industrial Carrot / Potato
• Wheat → Industrial Wheat; Hay Bale → Industrial Wheat Block
• Wheat, Melon or Pumpkin Seeds → Bagged Industrial Seeds
• Melon / Pumpkin block → Industrial Melon / Pumpkin

Converted crops start at Normal, Good or Excellent quality.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.growing.body:
Plant Industrial Carrots and Potatoes directly on farmland; plant bagged seeds the same way. A Bagged Industrial Carrot or Potato can also be unpacked into a single crop in the crafting grid.

Right-click a mature Industrial Carrot or Potato with an Empty Bag to collect one bagged crop: the plant resets and keeps growing, no replanting needed. On other mature industrial crops, a bag extracts 3–6 seeds once.

A Rapid Growth Fertilizer Bag finishes an industrial crop instantly.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.compress.bod:
The Crop Compressor packs 64 identical industrial crops into one crop block. Blocks save space and are worth far more energy later (3,200 FE each in a bio-energy generator).

Use a Fertile Soil Fertilizer Bag on farmland to turn it into Fertile Soil. Fertile Soil never dries out or degrades, and industrial crops planted on it give double harvests. Convert your whole field early.
guide.industrialcrops.crops.mixer.title: The Mixer
guide.industrialcrops.crops.mixer.body:
Right-click the Mixer with ingredients and an Empty Bag to load it; right-click with an empty hand to take the product.

• Bone Meal + Industrial Wheat + Sugar → Rapid Growth Fertilizer
• Dirt + Bone Meal + Industrial Wheat → Fertile Soil Fertilizer
• 2 Industrial Wheat (+2 Redstone / Sugar / Golden Carrot / Iron) → Normal, Rapid Breeding, Rapid Growth, Health Restoration or Resistance Boost Feed Bags

Feed bags work on animals and return the empty bag.
guide.industrialcrops.genetics.quality.b:
Every industrial carrot, potato, wheat, melon and pumpkin carries two quality genes. The dominant gene is the quality you see in the tooltip; the recessive gene is hidden.

Qualities from lowest to highest: Normal, Good, Excellent, Fine, Supreme, Super.

Insert a crop or seed bag into the Crop Analysis Device (iron tier) to read both genes.
Plant the same industrial crop side by side. When a plant matures, its seeds inherit one gene from itself and one from a random neighbour of the same kind.

If both picked genes are recessive, the offspring is promoted at least one tier above the better parent. Keep your best plants together, analyse the results and replant the winners. With patience every line reaches Super.
guide.industrialcrops.genetics.fusion.bo:
Breed an Industrial Melon and an Industrial Pumpkin up to Super quality, then fuse them in the Melon Modification Device to create a Fusion Melon.

Combine a Fusion Melon with a Netherite Ingot to make a Fusion Ingot. Three ingots form the Fusion Ingot Pickaxe: automatic Fortune III on ores, Silk Touch on everything else, and it can mine naturally generated unbreakable blocks.
guide.industrialcrops.exotic.exotic_seed:
Prism Pod, Embercoil, Starbloom, Neon Bulb and Fluxstalk are strange new plants.

Prism Pod, Embercoil and Starbloom seeds turn up in vanilla loot chests, and Wandering Traders sometimes sell them. Plant them like any seed; harvests drop more seeds.

Combine an Empty Bag with seeds to bag them. Collecting all five crops completes the An Unusual Garden advancement, and all five are needed for Strange Fertilizer.
guide.industrialcrops.exotic.strange_fer:
Mix one of each exotic crop with an Empty Bag in the Mixer to get a Strange Fertilizer Bag.

Use it on dirt-like blocks to turn them into purple Comet Soil. Apply Bone Meal to Comet Soil with open space above: each attempt has a chance to sprout a Comet Sapling.
Grow the Comet Sapling into a Comet Tree. Its logs make a full set of comet wood building blocks.

Breaking Comet Leaves without shears can drop saplings and, rarely, Comet Essence. Fortune improves both chances. Comet Essence is the key ingredient for the Crystal Steel Workbench and every crystal machine, so start a comet grove before the crystal tier.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.crop_sto:
Place Basic Storage Components next to a Basic Control Device. Right-click the controller to deposit or withdraw industrial carrots and potatoes in steps of 1 or 64.

Components connect through each other, so you can grow the array in any direction. This early storage only accepts industrial crops.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.pipes.bo:
A pipe line has three parts:

• Output Pipe: pulls items out of the container it touches.
• Pipe: carries items along the line.
• Input Pipe: pushes items into the container it touches.

Add a Pipe Sorter to route items with a whitelist or blacklist; an empty list lets everything through. Reinforced and Advanced pipes move items faster.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.manipula:
The Basic Manipulation Device makes Reinforced Control Devices and reinforced pipes. Select an output from its catalog and insert the listed materials. Iron Device Casings are crafted from 2 Iron Ingots and planks at a crafting table.

Both Basic and Reinforced Storage Components are made in the Component Programming Device. Make the basic component first, then upgrade it using an iron casing, iron and chests. Each reinforced component provides 54 storage slots.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.advanced:
In the Component Programming Device, make an Upgrade Kit Substrate from 2 Comparators, a Redstone Torch and an Iron Ingot. Program that substrate with 5 Gold Ingots into a Gold Upgrade Kit. Both steps use the programmer.

Right-click a Basic Manipulation Device with the kit to upgrade it in place. This kit supports only that device. The advanced catalog adds advanced pipes, gold fluid pipes, the Advanced Industrial Storage Device and matter-data machines.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.componen:
All 25 components, substrates and upgrade kits are manufactured in the Component Programming Device, never at a crafting table or another machine. JEI lists exact materials and counts.

First craft the device from 4 Gold Ingots, 2 Redstone, a Redstone Torch, a Comparator and a Crafting Table; no existing component is needed. In it, make a Component Substrate from 2 Comparators, a Redstone Torch and a Gold Ingot. Replace gold with iron for the Kit Substrate.

Recipes cover both substrates; Basic, Reinforced, 10K and Industrial Storage I–IV; Speed I–IV; Automatic, Guidance, Rapid-Fire, Power, Mining and both Dimension upgrades; AP Expansion I–III; and Gold/Crystal Steel kits. Tier dependencies remain. At most 5 input slots are needed.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.network_:
The Advanced Industrial Storage Device stores any item in Industrial Storage Components, with search and a built-in crafting terminal (JEI recipe transfer works).

A Remote Access Device binds to a controller, storage device or network terminal with a right-click. Use it to open that storage from up to 128 blocks away; install Dimension Upgrade Components in the target for unlimited or cross-dimension access.
guide.industrialcrops.logistics.automati:
The Automatic Sowing Device runs on FE and plants seeds on farmland across a 3×3 chunk area. It takes seeds from its own slots first, then from adjacent containers.

For defence or demolition, the Explosive Potato Launcher fires Explosive Potatoes (Industrial Potato, Gunpowder, Redstone) at the coordinates you enter. It needs a Guidance Component; Rapid-Fire and Power Components upgrade it.
The Component Substrate Integrated Gold Device Casing combines gold, planks and a Component Substrate for generators, energy storage, furnaces, extraction and sowing devices.

Make the substrate in the Component Programming Device from 2 Comparators, a Redstone Torch and a Gold Ingot. Cultivation machines no longer produce substrates; natural blue-slime loot is unchanged.
guide.industrialcrops.power.bio_energy.b:
The Bio-Energy Generation Device burns biomass into FE. Each item takes 8 seconds:

• Seeds: 25 FE
• Crops: 50 FE
• Crop blocks: 3,200 FE

Burning leaves residue. When the residue fills up the generator stops, so place an Incinerator next to it (or connect it by pipe) and give it any furnace fuel. It destroys the residue automatically.
guide.industrialcrops.power.grid.title: Building a Grid
guide.industrialcrops.power.grid.body:
Connect generators to machines with Basic Energy Cable; Advanced Energy Cable carries more power. The Gold Energy Storage Cabinet buffers 10,000,000 FE. Open its screen to set each side to input, output or disabled.

Your first big consumer is usually the Electric Furnace, which smelts three batches at once. All devices use standard FE, so power from other mods works too.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.plasma.bod:
Ripe Energy Bushes give Plasma Fruit when right-clicked. Feed the fruit to a powered Extraction Device to produce Concentrated Plasma Berry Juice.

Store the juice in a Copper Fluid Storage Cabinet, move it with Gold Fluid Pipes, or fill a bucket. A Plasma Juice Bucket can be poured into a cauldron.

Careful: stepping into plasma juice electrocutes you.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.energy_cry:
Throw a Diamond into plasma juice, either a cauldron or a pool. It transforms into an Energy Crystal.

Craft an Energy Crystal between two Iron Ingots to make a Crystal Ingot. Crystal Ingots, Iron and Planks form the Crystal Steel Casing, the frame of the crystal tier.
Comet Essence, a Crystal Steel Casing, a Crafting Table and a Copper Fluid Storage Cabinet make the Crystal Steel Workbench.

It crafts on a 5×5 grid and has its own fluid tank. Some recipes need fluid in the tank. Fill it with plasma juice before crafting them. JEI shows every workbench recipe, including the fluid it needs.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.crystal_ma:
The workbench builds the endgame helpers:

• Wireless Logistics Transfer Device: items and fluids between endpoints on the same channel.
• Crafting Processing Device: recursive auto-crafting from your storage.
• Terrain Processing Device: digs or fills whole chunks.
• Automatic Animal Breeder: feeds, breeds and caps livestock.
• Wireless Energy Transfer Device: powers machines in range (needs 1,000 mB plasma).
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.launch_sit:
Build a 3×3×3 launch site. Place the Crystal-steel Rocket Launch Device, then fill the 3×3 floor behind it with eight Crystal-steel Launch Platforms and stack Crystal-steel Launch Gantries two high on the four corners.

Put a Satellite Rocket (small 2, medium 3 or large 4 blocks tall) on the centre pad with clear sky above. Feed the controller FE and plasma juice, open it and press Launch.

Each satellite in orbit links every powered Crystal-steel Satellite Signal Receiver.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.reaction.b:
In the Component Programming Device, combine an Upgrade Kit Substrate with 5 Crystal Ingots to make a Crystal Steel Upgrade Kit.

Right-click a Bio-Energy Generation Device with it to upgrade to a Bio-Energy Reaction Device. Inventory and stored energy are retained; each fuel item produces twice the energy.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.digitize.bo:
Build these in the Advanced Manipulation Device. Place an Item Network Management Terminal, then connect a Matter Digitization Device to it.

Insert items into the digitizer and press Upload. They become data stored in the terminal, where you can browse and select them. Only allowed items can be uploaded.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.copy_rebuil:
Select an entry in the terminal, then:

• Data Copying Device: drains a full 10,000 FE charge to add one copy of the selected data. Insert an Automatic Component to keep copying until you click again.
• Matter Reconstruction Device: turns selected data back into a real item at 5 FE per tick.

Together they let you multiply valuable materials with power.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.forest.body:
Connect a Digital Miniature Forest to your item network and select digitized sapling data. It grows a virtual tree and adds the logs straight to the network as data. Each vanilla tree type has its own yield.

Speed Components I–IV make many machines, including this one, work faster.
guide.industrialcrops.matter.slimes.body:
Right-click a slime with a Slime Conversion Device to capture it. Place the device and insert copper, iron, gold or diamond to convert the stored slime.

The Slime Cultivation Device accepts only vanilla, copper, iron and gold slime converters or eggs, producing slime balls or the corresponding ingots. It cannot cultivate blue substrate slimes into components. Natural blue-slime drops remain; manufacture substrates in the Component Programming Device.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.carrote.bo:
The digitizer's tooltip whispers: try an Industrial Carrot. Do it only when you are ready.

Uploading Industrial Carrots overloads the Matter Digitization Device: it explodes and is destroyed, you drop to 1 health with the Glitch effect, and every carrot becomes a Carrote. Build a spare digitizer first and stand somewhere safe.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.forge.body:
Fill a cauldron with lava and right-click it with a Carrote. The cauldron turns into a Paradox Steel Forge.

Put Carrotes and Netherite Ingots into the forge. Each cycle takes 5 seconds and turns one Carrote and one alloy ingot into a Paradox Steel Ingot. Nine ingots make a Paradox Steel Block.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.paradox_de:
Wrap a Paradox Steel Ingot in Polished Blackstone to make the Paradox Steel Device Casing.

• Matter Hardening Device: makes an inserted item unbreakable.
• Universal Replication Device: place it left of an energy device to create an independent copy of it.
• Mimic Block: place it left of a block; after five seconds it becomes that block.
guide.industrialcrops.carrote.stable_mat:
Upload a Paradox Steel Ingot through the Matter Digitization Device. Its data settles into Stable Matter, which a Matter Reconstruction Device can rebuild as Stable Matter Ingots.

Stable Matter Ingots are used to make Mimic Blocks. Fusion Ingots are made from a Fusion Melon and a Netherite Ingot.
guide.industrialcrops.curios.finding.bod:
More than twenty Carrote accessories hide in village chests. Each one grants a single ability: extra damage, flight, night vision, a damage shield, peaceful surroundings, better loot and more.

A Carrote works in your main hand, offhand or any Carrote slot when Curios is installed. Identical effects do not stack. Hold Shift over a Carrote to read its exact effect.
guide.industrialcrops.curios.equipping.b:
The Helmet Carrote goes in your head slot and copies one other Carrote: first from the Carrote slot, then from your offhand. It shows Not copied when the copy would add nothing.

The Ultimate Carrote is a pouch. Right-click to store Carrotes inside; while it sits in your offhand or an accessory slot, every Carrote stored in it or carried in your inventory is active.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.satelli: Directs satellites in orbit to mine in space. Needs a powered Crystal-steel Satellite Signal Receiver and an Item Network Management Terminal within 8 blocks; mined ore goes into the terminal. Uses 200 FE/t while mining.
gui.industrialcrops.satellite_control.re: Reached by: small, medium and large satellite rockets
Reached by: medium and large satellite rockets
gui.industrialcrops.satellite_control.lo: Locked: no satellite in orbit can reach it
A satellite wore out and burned up
gui.industrialcrops.satellite_control.st: Place a Crystal-steel Satellite Signal Receiver within 8 blocks
The Crystal-steel Satellite Signal Receiver needs power
Place a network terminal within 8 blocks
No satellite can reach this area
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.space_mini:
Every satellite rocket is built with two pickaxes. The satellite's durability is the remaining durability of those pickaxes, so use fresh ones. Each space mining cycle wears one point; at zero the satellite is destroyed.

Place a Crystal-steel Satellite Control Device with a powered Crystal-steel Satellite Signal Receiver and an Item Network Management Terminal within 8 blocks. Open it, click a mining area on the map and press Start. The Small Satellite Rocket only reaches area I; medium satellites reach area II and large ones area III.

Ore arrives in the terminal: Green Iron, Inv and Tycon Ore. Smelt them into ingots.
gui.industrialcrops.ultra_high_pressure_: Click a recipe to select it
gui.industrialcrops.ap.upgrade.power_hel: Power Component: −25%% FE per component (up to 3).
gui.industrialcrops.ap.upgrade.chunk_hel: Either Dimension component loads every chunk intersecting the actual structure footprint. Tickets update on resize or removal. This does not expand the structure.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_agriculture.upgra: Speed Component I–IV: plants up to 4 seeds per tick and adds 2 growth ticks per boost level for each tier.
Automatic Component: harvests ripe crops (seeds refill the seed row, produce goes to the output row) and pushes the output row into adjacent containers.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.upgrade: Speed Component I–IV: work cycle every 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.35 / 0.25 s instead of every second.
Automatic Component: pushes the output row into adjacent containers every second.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_stru: Stores 9 AP Structural Steel and works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.inv_blo: Compact storage for 9 Inv Ingots. Works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.tycon_b: Compact storage for 9 Tycon Ingots. Works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.green_i: Compact storage for 9 Green Iron Ingots. Works as a beacon base.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_stee: Material for AP device recipes and building decoration. Farm and ranch formation no longer requires underground casing foundations.
Pillars and roof ribs for the AP greenhouse. Follow the projection.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_agri: AP glass-greenhouse controller. Footprints: 16×16, then 32×16, 32×32 and 48×48. Requires a complete frame, glass enclosure/roof, entrance, work area and at least one source-water block in range. No underground foundation or uniform floor is checked. Planting still needs farmland below each crop. Six upgrade slots.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_live: AP open-air ranch controller. Mount it above the fence to the right of the gate, viewed from outside. Footprints: 16×16, then 32×16, 32×32 and 48×48. Requires fences, gate, small shelter, trough, composter and at least one source-water block. Ground is unrestricted; no underground foundation. Named and tamed animals are protected.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.title: Building AP structures
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.breed.t: Breeds pairs of each species with feed from the feed row (feed bags work too) until the cap is reached.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.shear.t: Shears every sheep with wool; the wool goes to the output row.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.cull.ti: Slaughters adults above the cap so pens never overflow. Drops go to the output row.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.grow.ti: Spends FE to make babies grow up faster.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.origin: u runs clockwise from facing; v behind. Farm controller: h=0. Ranch controller: h=1, with gate/animal plane h=0. Mount the ranch controller above the fence right of the gate, viewed from outside. No chunk alignment needed.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.farm: Farm: AP frames, glass walls/pitched roof, wooden door and rear work area. No underground foundation, uniform floor or fixed channels. At least one source in h=-1..6; waterlogged sources count, flowing water does not. Planting still needs farmland below.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.ranch: Ranch: controller above the fence right of the gate; any fences, 7×7 wooden shelter, hay trough and composter. No uniform floor or fixed drinking pool. At least one source in h=-1..3, including waterlogged blocks.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.expansion: Base:16×16; I:32×16; II:32×32; III:48×48. The highest installed expansion sets the size. Complete the enlarged structure yourself before operation resumes.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.help.projection: Cyan ghosts show missing blocks. Red boxes show wrong blocks or spaces to clear. Nearby missing parts are prioritised; move closer to other areas to inspect them.
gui.industrialcrops.ap.upgrade.expansion: AP Expansion I/II/III: 32×16 / 32×32 / 48×48. Only the highest tier applies. Complete the frame, enclosure, roof and facilities yourself and retain a source in range; no foundation or uniform floor is required.
gui.industrialcrops.ap_livestock.cap.tip: Retention cap per species inside the validated pasture. Higher caps suit larger pens. Breeding stops at the cap; culling handles surplus adults. Named and tamed animals remain protected.
guide.industrialcrops.ap.sizes.title: Footprints and expansion
guide.industrialcrops.ap.sizes.body:
The base 16×16 footprint equals one chunk in area. AP Expansion I, II and III require 32×16, 32×32 and 48×48 blocks: 2, 4 and 9 chunk areas. Actual chunk-border alignment is unnecessary.

u increases clockwise from controller facing, v towards its back. The farm controller is at (W/2-1,0,0); its level is h=0, the crop plane. Planting soil is h=-1. For ranches, h=0 is one block below the controller: the controller is (W/2-1,1,0), with a fence directly below at h=0. The gate is (W/2,0,0). Viewed from outside, the controller sits above the fence right of the gate.

Six upgrade slots support speed, power saving, automation, dimension and AP expansion. Install only the highest expansion tier and build the full larger structure. Neither layout checks fixed blocks below h=0. Foundation and ground checks pass automatically once loaded. Keep at least one source-water block in range.
guide.industrialcrops.ap.farm.title: Glass vegetable greenhouse
guide.industrialcrops.ap.ranch.title: Open-air livestock pen
guide.industrialcrops.ap.projection.body:
Enable the controller hologram: cyan marks missing parts, red marks wrong materials or spaces to clear. At most 256 nearby hints appear; move closer to inspect distant areas. There are no underground parts or fixed water-channel/pool positions in the projection.

Of nine statuses, No foundation required and Unrestricted ground pass automatically once the range is loaded. The others check frame, enclosure, roof, entrance, facilities, clearance and at least one source. Farm sources may be h=-1..6; ranch sources h=-1..3. Waterlogged sources count, flowing water does not. Unloaded structures pause operation.

Tag-based alternatives allow regular and all 16 stained glasses/panes, excluding tinted glass; wood species may mix for doors, fences, planks, slabs and stairs. Waterlogged parts must still satisfy material and clearance rules.

Farms work only on h=0: planting needs air above actual farmland, but the whole underground floor is not checked. Ranch actions and drop collection stay inside; outside, named and tamed animals remain protected.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.ap_expa: Install in an AP Farm or Ranch upgrade slot to require a 32×16 footprint (2 chunks in area). Only the highest expansion tier applies. Build the complete larger greenhouse or ranch yourself.
Install in an AP Farm or Ranch upgrade slot to require a 32×32 footprint (4 chunks in area). Only the highest expansion tier applies. Build the complete larger greenhouse or ranch yourself.
Install in an AP Farm or Ranch upgrade slot to require a 48×48 footprint (9 chunks in area). Only the highest expansion tier applies. Build the complete larger greenhouse or ranch yourself.
guide.industrialcrops.ap.farm.body:
Use W×D. The farm controller is (u,h,v)=(W/2-1,0,0); a two-block wooden door is beside it at (W/2,0,0). Crops stand at h=0 and need actual farmland at h=-1 for planting. Structure formation does not inspect underground materials or require a uniform floor.

No AP casing foundation, fully tilled floor, plank path or fixed water channels are required. Arrange crops and natural soil freely; vanilla farmland hydration still applies. Any source within the footprint at h=-1..6 passes the water check, including waterlogged blocks; flowing water does not. Keep the composter at (2,0,D-3) and crafting table at (3,0,D-3).

The roof repeats every 16 columns. With r=u modulo 16, H=3+floor(min(r,15-r)/2): edges h=3, ridge h=6. Cover W×D; arches at v=0,8,16,... and D-1 use AP frames, other roof cells glass.

At arch intersections with u=0,W-1,16,32,..., frame pillars rise from h=0 through H-1. Skip internal pillars on u=W/2. Fill other outer walls with glass up to H-1, retaining controller and door. Keep growing spaces clear; water cannot replace required parts or excuse solid obstructions.
guide.industrialcrops.ap.ranch.body:
For ranches h=0 is one block below the controller, the level of animals, fences and the gate. Place the controller at (W/2-1,1,0), any fence directly below at (W/2-1,0,0), and any fence gate beside that fence at (W/2,0,0). Viewed from outside, the controller is above the fence right of the gate. Keep space above the gate clear.

Fence the h=0 perimeter except the gate. No fixed blocks below h=0, casing foundation, plank floor or grass/dirt floor are required; keep natural terrain if desired. Any source within the footprint at h=-1..3 suffices, including waterlogged blocks. Flowing water does not count; no fixed drinking pool is needed.

The 7×7 shelter occupies u=W-8..W-2,v=D-8..D-2. Fence posts rise at its four corners from h=0 through 2; cover h=3 with planks, wooden slabs or stairs. No shelter-floor material is required. Leave the rest open-air.

The trough is h=0,u=W-8..W-4,v=D-7..D-5: a 5×3 wooden-slab rim around three hay blocks. Put the composter at (W-6,0,D-4). Keep other h=0..2 interior spaces clear; grass is allowed, solid waterlogged obstructions are not.

Insert feed into the controller; trough hay remains required. Per-species caps are 8,16,32 or64. After expansion, complete the new fence and move the shelter/trough to the new rear positions. The source may remain anywhere suitable inside the enlarged range.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.super_c: Presses 10,000 Industrial Potatoes into one 10K Compressed Potato. Accepts Industrial Potatoes and Industrial Potato Blocks (64 each) by hand or by pipe; speed components shorten the press time.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.expanda: Unified storage: each item type takes one slot. Install 10K Storage Components to unlock 54 item types each and store up to 9,999 of every type. Keeps its contents when broken.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.compres: Pressed from 10,000 Industrial Potatoes. Used to make a 10K Storage Component.
tooltip.industrialcrops.expandable_compo: Install in an Expandable Storage Device
jei.industrialcrops.info.super_compresso: Crafted at the Crystal Steel Workbench from AP Structural Steel, pistons, Crystal Steel Casings and a Crop Compressor. Feed it 10,000 Industrial Potatoes (Industrial Potato Blocks count as 64) to make one 10K Compressed Potato.
jei.industrialcrops.info.compressed_pota: Pressed from 10,000 Industrial Potatoes in the Super Compressor. In the Component Programming Device, combine it with 4 units of AP Structural Steel and 4 Component Substrates for a 10K Storage Component.
jei.industrialcrops.info.expandable_stor: Stores one slot per item type. Each 10K Storage Component installed in the cell drawer unlocks 54 item types and raises the per-type limit to 9,999. Supports search, sorting, the crafting grid, pipes and the Remote Access Device.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.speed_c: Install in an equipment upgrade slot; only the highest speed tier applies. Standard processors: ×2 speed. Terrain: up to 16 blocks per 4 ticks. AP Farm: 1 planting per tick and 5 growth ticks per boost level. AP Ranch: 15-tick work interval.

Install in an equipment upgrade slot; only the highest speed tier applies. Standard processors: ×4 speed. Terrain: up to one layer per 4 ticks. AP Farm: 2 plantings per tick and 7 growth ticks per boost level. AP Ranch: 10-tick work interval.

Install in an equipment upgrade slot; only the highest speed tier applies. Standard processors: ×8 speed. Terrain: up to one layer per tick. AP Farm: 3 plantings per tick and 9 growth ticks per boost level. AP Ranch: 7-tick work interval.

Install in an equipment upgrade slot; only the highest speed tier applies. Standard processors: one processing cycle per tick. Terrain: up to the whole selected volume per tick. AP Farm: 4 plantings per tick and 11 growth ticks per boost level. AP Ranch: 5-tick work interval.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.power_c: In the Explosive Potato Launcher, 1/2/3/4 components set both shot power and potatoes per shot to 4/8/12/16 times the base value (one potato without a component). In the AP Farm or Ranch, each component reduces energy use by 25%, up to three components.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.rapid_f: Install in the Explosive Potato Launcher to remove its 100-tick (5-second) firing cooldown. Limited to one component per launcher.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.mining_: Install in a Terrain Processor upgrade slot to clear naturally unbreakable blocks such as bedrock. Does not apply in fill mode. Still respects protection and skips blocks with block entities.
jei.industrialcrops.info.carrote: No recipe. Put Industrial Carrots into a Matter Digitization Device and start an upload. The digitizer overloads and is destroyed, you drop to 1 health with the Glitch effect, and every Industrial Carrot becomes a Carrote. Build a spare digitizer and stand somewhere safe.
jei.industrialcrops.info.carrote_accesso: No recipe. Carrote accessories are found in village chests (25% chance per chest, one random accessory). Hold Shift over one to read its effect. With Curios installed they also fit the Carrote slot.
jei.industrialcrops.info.paradox_steel_f: No recipe. Fill a cauldron with lava and right-click it with a Carrote: the cauldron turns into a Paradox Steel Forge.
jei.industrialcrops.info.paradox_steel_i: Made in the Paradox Steel Forge: every 5 seconds it turns one Carrote and one Netherite Ingot into a Paradox Steel Ingot.
jei.industrialcrops.info.stable_matter_i: Upload a Paradox Steel Ingot through the Matter Digitization Device. Its data settles into Stable Matter, which a Matter Reconstruction Device rebuilds as Stable Matter Ingots.
jei.industrialcrops.info.exotic_seeds: Found in vanilla loot chests (25% chance per chest) and sometimes sold by Wandering Traders. Harvests drop more seeds.
jei.industrialcrops.info.space_ores: Only obtainable by space mining. Launch a satellite and run it from a Crystal-steel Satellite Control Device. Area 1: 75% Green Iron, 25% INV. Area 2: 50% INV, 30% Green Iron, 20% Tycon. Area 3: 60% Tycon, 25% INV, 15% Green Iron. Each cycle has a 25% chance to yield two ores.
jei.industrialcrops.info.comet_soil: Use a Strange Fertilizer Bag on a dirt-like block to turn it into Comet Soil.
jei.industrialcrops.info.comet_sapling: Apply Bone Meal to Comet Soil with open space above: each attempt has a chance to sprout a Comet Sapling. Comet Leaves broken without shears can also drop saplings.
jei.industrialcrops.info.comet_essence: Rare drop from Comet Leaves broken without shears. Fortune increases the chance.
jei.industrialcrops.info.plasma_fruit: Right-click a ripe Energy Bush to pick Plasma Fruit. Plant the fruit to grow more Energy Bushes.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.compone: Blank for industrial components and some device recipes; not installable in upgrade slots.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.upgrade: Combine with gold or crystal ingots to make an upgrade kit; the blank cannot be installed.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.guidanc: Guidance material used to craft the Explosive Potato Launcher, satellite rockets and related space equipment. Cannot be installed in equipment upgrade slots.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.industr: Install in the storage-cell drawer of an Advanced Industrial Storage Device or Reinforced Control Device to unlock 54 slots per cell. Limits: 999 items per slot in advanced storage, 99 in reinforced control. Reinforced controllers prioritize connected external storage components.

Install in the storage-cell drawer of an Advanced Industrial Storage Device or Reinforced Control Device to unlock 108 slots per cell. Limits: 999 items per slot in advanced storage, 99 in reinforced control. Reinforced controllers prioritize connected external storage components.

Install in the storage-cell drawer of an Advanced Industrial Storage Device or Reinforced Control Device to unlock 216 slots per cell. Limits: 999 items per slot in advanced storage, 99 in reinforced control. Reinforced controllers prioritize connected external storage components.

Install in the storage-cell drawer of an Advanced Industrial Storage Device or Reinforced Control Device to unlock 864 slots per cell. Limits: 999 items per slot in advanced storage, 99 in reinforced control. Reinforced controllers prioritize connected external storage components.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.storage: Install in the Expandable Storage Device cell drawer. Each cell adds 54 item types, with up to 9,999 items per type. Holds up to 6 cells; type counts add together but the per-type limit does not.
tooltip.industrialcrops.upgrade.no_devic: Crafting material; cannot be installed directly in equipment.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.super_c: Cultivates new plant varieties from Super-quality industrial crops. Put a Super crop in the top slot and the recipe's materials in the three material slots below (any order; a recipe uses one to three). Growing takes 1 minute and needs no power. Containers such as Dragon's Breath bottles come back in the slot under the output. Recipes: Super Industrial Carrot + Comet Essence + Prism Pod → Black Nebula Carrot; Super Industrial Carrot + Dragon's Breath + Neon Bulb → Purple Dragon Carrot. Pipes can insert crops and materials and extract the harvest and bottles.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.black_n: A carrot grown from starlight. Restores 16 hunger and 16 saturation. Can be planted on farmland. A mature crop yields 2–4 carrots at random; an immature crop yields 1.
gui.industrialcrops.super_crop_cultivato: Insert a Super-quality industrial crop to see what it can become.
guide.industrialcrops.genetics.cultivato:
Breed a crop to Super quality, then let the Super Crop Cultivator turn it into a brand-new plant variety. Build it on the Crystal Steel Workbench.

Put the Super crop in the top slot and the materials in the three material slots below. Order does not matter; a recipe uses one to three materials, and unused slots must stay empty. Faded items show what is still missing. Each cultivation takes one minute and needs no power. Crops that are not Super quality are refused. Bottles are kept: they come back in the slot under the output.

Black Nebula Carrot: Super Industrial Carrot + Comet Essence + Prism Pod. Restores 16 hunger and 16 saturation.

Purple Dragon Carrot: Super Industrial Carrot + Dragon's Breath + Neon Bulb. Restores 8 hunger and 8 saturation and grants 30 seconds of Dragon Breath, a swirling cloud that deals 6 damage per second to nearby mobs.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.purple_: A carrot steeped in dragon's breath. Restores 8 hunger and 8 saturation and grants Dragon Breath for 30 seconds: a cloud of Ender Dragon breath swirls around you and deals 6 magic damage per second to mobs within 3 blocks. Players and your own pets are spared. Can be eaten even when full. Can be planted on farmland. A mature crop yields 2–4 carrots at random; an immature crop yields 1.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.omni_bu: Right-click a cauldron to fill it with Omni Potion. The bucket never runs dry. Draw Omni Potions from the cauldron with Glass Bottles (3 per fill).
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.omni_po: Grants every beneficial vanilla effect for 3 minutes: Speed, Haste, Strength, Jump Boost, Regeneration, Resistance, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Invisibility, Night Vision, Health Boost, Absorption, Luck, Slow Falling, Conduit Power, Dolphin's Grace and Hero of the Village, plus Instant Health and Saturation. Grows an Omni Carrot in the Super Crop Cultivator.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.omni_ca: Restores 12 hunger and 12 saturation and grants every beneficial vanilla effect for 5 minutes. Can be eaten even when full. Can be planted on farmland. A mature crop yields 2–4 carrots at random; an immature crop yields 1.
jei.industrialcrops.info.omni_bucket: Crafted on the Crystal Steel Workbench: a Bucket in the centre surrounded by a Beacon, a Conduit, Potions of Healing, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Invisibility, Night Vision and Slow Falling (long or strong versions also work), a Golden Apple and a Suspicious Stew with Saturation (made with a Dandelion or Blue Orchid). Right-click any cauldron to fill it with Omni Potion; the bucket is kept.
jei.industrialcrops.info.omni_potion: Fill a cauldron with the Omni Bucket, then right-click it with Glass Bottles. Each fill gives 3 Omni Potions, and the bucket can refill it forever. Omni Potions can also be poured back into a cauldron.
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.omni.title: Omni Bucket
guide.industrialcrops.crystal.omni.body:
Gather every buff source and craft the Omni Bucket on the Crystal Steel Workbench. Put the Bucket in the centre:

• Top: Beacon
• Second row: Potions of Healing, Fire Resistance and Water Breathing
• Middle row: Potion of Invisibility, Bucket, Potion of Night Vision
• Fourth row: Potion of Slow Falling, Golden Apple, Suspicious Stew with Saturation (Dandelion or Blue Orchid)
• Bottom: Conduit

Long and strong potion versions also work.

Right-click any cauldron with the Omni Bucket to fill it with shimmering Omni Potion. The bucket never runs dry. Glass Bottles draw Omni Potions, 3 per fill. An Omni Potion grants every beneficial vanilla effect for 3 minutes.

In the Super Crop Cultivator, a Super Industrial Carrot and an Omni Potion grow an Omni Carrot: 12 hunger, 12 saturation and every beneficial effect for 5 minutes.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.integra: A powered, chest-style furnace: anything smeltable placed in its 3x9 grid is smelted automatically, up to 9 stacks at once. Storage upgrades open more rows and larger slots; speed components shorten the smelt time.
gui.industrialcrops.integrated_smelting_: Industrial Storage Component I-IV: 4 rows / 5 rows / 6 rows x99 / 6 rows x999
jei.industrialcrops.info.integrated_smel: Crafted at the Crystal Steel Workbench. Once powered, it smelts everything smeltable inside its grid, up to nine stacks in parallel (20 FE per stack per tick). The Smelt Mode tab picks how far items go: once, twice, or to the end of the smelting chain. Finished items are marked with an amber line and stay in their slot. Industrial Storage Components I-IV expand it to 4x9, 5x9, 6x9 with 99 per slot and 6x9 with 999 per slot. Pipes insert into unfinished slots and extract finished items.
gui.industrialcrops.integrated_smelting_: Each item is smelted one time (raw iron → iron ingot).
Results are smelted a second time when possible (cobblestone → stone → smooth stone).
Results keep smelting until they cannot be smelted any further.
